sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM fact_orders LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(order_value) AS total_revenue FROM fact_orders LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count FROM fact_orders LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM dim_seller LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS no_category_count FROM dim_product WHERE category_en IS NULL AND category_pt IS NULL LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_boleto_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE AND payment_type_main = 'boleto' LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM fact_orders LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE is_late = TRUE LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_delivered = TRUE AND is_late = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS on_time_delivery_rate_pct FROM fact_orders LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS canceled_orders FROM fact_orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight_value FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_count FROM dim_customer WHERE state = 'Rio de Janeiro' LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT d.month_name, d.year_month, SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_date AS d ON o.purchase_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.date >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND d.date <= CAST('2018-08-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.month_name, d.year_month ORDER BY d.year_month) SELECT month_name, ROUND(((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month), 0)) * 100, 2) AS month_over_month_growth_pct FROM monthly_revenue LIMIT 1000
SELECT s.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM dim_seller AS s JOIN fact_order_items AS oi ON s.seller_key = oi.seller_key GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

WITH seller_stats AS (SELECT ds.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered THEN fo.order_id END) AS delivered_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered AND NOT fo.is_late THEN fo.order_id END) AS on_time_orders FROM dim_seller AS ds JOIN fact_order_items AS foi ON ds.seller_key = foi.seller_key JOIN fact_orders AS fo ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id GROUP BY ds.seller_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.is_delivered THEN fo.order_id END) >= 100) SELECT seller_id, delivered_orders, ROUND(on_time_orders * 100.0 / NULLIF(delivered_orders, 0), 2) AS on_time_rate_pct FROM seller_stats ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.state = 'São Paulo' THEN f.order_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.order_value), 0), 2) AS share_percent FROM fact_orders AS f JOIN dim_customer AS c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key LIMIT 1000

WITH delivered_counts AS (SELECT dc.customer_key, COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders FROM dim_customer AS dc JOIN fact_orders AS fo ON dc.customer_key = fo.customer_key WHERE fo.is_delivered = TRUE GROUP BY dc.customer_key), total_customers AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) AS total FROM dim_customer AS dc JOIN fact_orders AS fo ON dc.customer_key = fo.customer_key) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.customer_key) FROM delivered_counts AS dc WHERE dc.delivered_orders > 1) / NULLIF(tc.total, 0), 2) AS percentage FROM total_customers AS tc LIMIT 1000

WITH cat_rev AS (SELECT p.category_en AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM fact_order_items AS oi JOIN dim_product AS p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category_en), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM cat_rev), top10 AS (SELECT category, revenue FROM cat_rev ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10), top10_sum AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS top10_revenue FROM top10) SELECT ROUND((t.top10_revenue / tr.total_revenue) * 100, 2) AS share_percent FROM top10_sum AS t, total_rev AS tr LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders WHERE delay_days > 7 LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly_stats AS (SELECT d.year, d.month, d.year_month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(f.is_late) AS late_orders FROM fact_orders AS f JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key WHERE (d.year = 2017 AND d.month >= 1) OR (d.year = 2018 AND d.month <= 8) GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.year_month), monthly_rate AS (SELECT year_month, (late_orders * 100.0 / total_orders) AS late_rate_pct FROM monthly_stats) SELECT year_month, late_rate_pct FROM monthly_rate WHERE late_rate_pct = (SELECT MAX(late_rate_pct) FROM monthly_rate) LIMIT 1000

SELECT payment_type_main, QUANTILE_CONT(approval_hours, 0.5 ORDER BY approval_hours) AS median_approval_hours FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE AND payment_type_main IN ('boleto', 'credit card') GROUP BY payment_type_main LIMIT 1000

WITH total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(price) AS total FROM fact_order_items), seller_rev AS (SELECT seller_key, SUM(price) AS rev FROM fact_order_items GROUP BY seller_key), ranked AS (SELECT seller_key, rev, SUM(rev) OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) AS cum_rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rn FROM seller_rev) SELECT MIN(rn) AS smallest_num_sellers FROM ranked, total_rev WHERE cum_rev >= 0.8 * total LIMIT 1000

SELECT ((SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2018 THEN f.order_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2017 THEN f.order_value ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2017 THEN f.order_value ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100) AS revenue_growth_pct FROM fact_orders AS f JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.month = 8 LIMIT 1000

WITH order_category_distinct AS (SELECT DISTINCT fo.order_id, dp.category_en AS category, fo.is_delivered, fo.is_late FROM fact_orders AS fo JOIN fact_order_items AS foi ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id JOIN dim_product AS dp ON foi.product_key = dp.product_key WHERE fo.is_delivered = TRUE) SELECT category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_late = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS on_time_rate_pct FROM order_category_distinct GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500 ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT d.year, SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_date AS d ON o.purchase_date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.year ORDER BY d.year LIMIT 1000
SELECT c.state, SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_customer AS c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.state ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT d.month_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM fact_orders AS f JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2018 AND f.is_delivered = TRUE GROUP BY d.month_name, d.year_month ORDER BY d.year_month LIMIT 1000

WITH state_delivered AS (SELECT c.state, COUNT(*) AS total_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_late = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_delivered FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_customer AS c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_key WHERE o.is_delivered = TRUE GROUP BY c.state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500) SELECT state, ROUND(on_time_delivered * 100.0 / total_delivered, 2) AS on_time_rate_pct FROM state_delivered ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT dp.category_en AS product_category, SUM(foi.price) AS total_revenue FROM fact_order_items AS foi JOIN dim_product AS dp ON foi.product_key = dp.product_key GROUP BY dp.category_en ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN is_late THEN 'late' ELSE 'on time' END AS delivery_status, AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders GROUP BY delivery_status ORDER BY CASE WHEN delivery_status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1000
SELECT payment_type_main, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM fact_orders GROUP BY payment_type_main ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type_main = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS credit_card_percentage FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE LIMIT 1000
SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM dim_seller GROUP BY state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT c.state, AVG(o.delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days FROM fact_orders AS o JOIN dim_customer AS c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_key GROUP BY c.state ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(f.order_value) AS revenue FROM fact_orders AS f JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2017 AND d.month = 11 LIMIT 1000

WITH order_day_counts AS (SELECT d.weekday_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_orders AS f JOIN dim_date AS d ON f.purchase_date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.weekday_name) SELECT weekday_name, order_count FROM order_day_counts ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_5_star_reviews FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE AND NOT review_score IS NULL LIMIT 1000

WITH delivered_customer_counts AS (SELECT f.customer_key FROM fact_orders AS f WHERE f.is_delivered = TRUE GROUP BY f.customer_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_multiple_delivered_orders FROM delivered_customer_counts LIMIT 1000
SELECT AVG(n_items) AS avg_items_per_delivered_order FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM fact_order_items AS oi JOIN dim_product AS p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE p.category_en = 'office_furniture' LIMIT 1000
SELECT payment_type_main, AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM fact_orders GROUP BY payment_type_main LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_orders_with_one_star_review FROM fact_orders WHERE is_delivered = TRUE AND review_score = 1 LIMIT 1000
